tools.name: simpleams_get_me
tools.description: Show the user the API key belongs to and the key's permissions. Use it first to confirm the key works. SimpleAMS API: GET /me.

tools.name: simpleams_list_clients
tools.description: List clients the key can see, with optional search and filters. Social Security numbers are never returned. SimpleAMS API: GET /clients.

tools.name: simpleams_get_client
tools.description: Get one client, including phones, addresses and dependents. SimpleAMS API: GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_create_client
tools.description: Create a client. Required: first_name, last_name, client_type. Add other fields in fields. Creating runs the same audit, notification and webhook steps as the app. SimpleAMS API: POST /clients.

tools.name: simpleams_update_client
tools.description: Update a client. Send only the fields to change in fields; other fields keep their values. SimpleAMS API: PUT /clients/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_list_policies
tools.description: List policies with optional search and filters. SimpleAMS API: GET /policies.

tools.name: simpleams_get_policy
tools.description: Get one policy. SimpleAMS API: GET /policies/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_create_policy
tools.description: Create a policy. Required: client_id, agent_id, carrier_id, policy_number, policy_status, effective_date (yyyy-mm-dd). Creating runs the same renewal and commission processing as the app. SimpleAMS API: POST /policies.

tools.name: simpleams_update_policy
tools.description: Update a policy. Send only the fields to change in fields. Updating runs the same renewal and commission processing as the app. SimpleAMS API: PUT /policies/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_list_leads
tools.description: List leads with optional search and filters, including date range. SimpleAMS API: GET /leads.

tools.name: simpleams_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead. SimpleAMS API: GET /leads/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_create_lead
tools.description: Create a lead. Required: first_name, last_name, status. Paid-marketing fields (lead_cost, marketing_platform, marketing_platform_other) go in fields. SimpleAMS API: POST /leads.

tools.name: simpleams_update_lead
tools.description: Update a lead. Send only the fields to change in fields. SimpleAMS API: PUT /leads/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_list_agents
tools.description: List agents with optional search and status filter. Social Security numbers and dates of birth are never returned. SimpleAMS API: GET /agents.

tools.name: simpleams_get_agent
tools.description: Get one agent. SimpleAMS API: GET /agents/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_create_agent
tools.description: Create an agent. Required: first_name, last_name, email, phone_direct, agent_code, status, address (city, state, zip_code), system_access_option (none, create or link). Other fields go in fields. SimpleAMS API: POST /agents.

tools.name: simpleams_update_agent
tools.description: Update an agent. Send only the fields to change in fields. SimpleAMS API: PUT /agents/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_list_carriers
tools.description: List insurance carriers with optional search and status filter. SimpleAMS API: GET /carriers.

tools.name: simpleams_get_carrier
tools.description: Get one carrier. SimpleAMS API: GET /carriers/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_create_carrier
tools.description: Create a carrier. Required: name, status (Active or Inactive). Other fields go in fields. SimpleAMS API: POST /carriers.

tools.name: simpleams_update_carrier
tools.description: Update a carrier. Send only the fields to change in fields. SimpleAMS API: PUT /carriers/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_list_documents
tools.description: List documents with optional filters: collection, search, and the record they attach to (related_type and related_id). SimpleAMS API: GET /documents.

tools.name: simpleams_get_document
tools.description: Get the details of one document (name, type, size, the record it attaches to). SimpleAMS API: GET /documents/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_download_document
tools.description: Download one document. Returns the content as base64 when it is at most 32768 bytes; larger files must be downloaded in the app. SimpleAMS API: GET /documents/{id}/download.

tools.name: simpleams_upload_document
tools.description: Attach a file to a client, policy, lead or carrier. Send the file as base64 in content_base64 (10 MB maximum). Allowed types: pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, txt, csv, jpg, jpeg, png. policy_id is allowed only when uploading to a client. SimpleAMS API: POST /{type}/{id}/documents.

tools.name: simpleams_list_commissions
tools.description: List commission transactions (read-only) with filters for agent, carrier, policy, type, status, source and date range. SimpleAMS API: GET /commissions.

tools.name: simpleams_get_commission
tools.description: Get one commission transaction (read-only). SimpleAMS API: GET /commissions/{id}.

tools.name: simpleams_import_commission_statement
tools.description: Import a carrier commission statement with all its lines in one call. The statement arrives as Pending Review with unmatched lines; the user runs Auto-Match in the app. At most 700 lines per call. The key's user needs the Import Commission Statements permission. SimpleAMS API: POST /commission-state
